_about.what: Provenance for the sent_embeddings namespaces this repo writes. The stash key is {embedder, prompt, text} and carries NO producer, so a namespace cannot answer how its entries were made. registrar [6018]: the stash is a container the _about ruling never reached. This file is that record, kept beside the data rather than in the key.
_about.why_it_matters: Two runs can agree on every component of a namespace and still have split the same text differently, because the namespace records WHICH SPLITTER RAN, not WHICH RULE CHOSE IT -- and the rule is part of the treatment (lacan [6017]).

BAAI/bge-m3|<splitter>|refuse-untrunc-20.routing_signal: CJK share of the passage TEXT

BAAI/bge-m3|<splitter>|refuse-untrunc-20.note: The shard jsonl records `ref` WITHOUT the run suffix -- that is what the producer ran under. The suffix exists only in the stash key.
